title: Frequency Spectrum Display Explorer
description: Three sounds, three unmistakable bar shapes -- and the habit of naming the shape before naming the sound.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Sensor, Sound, and IoT Project Kits

educational.audience: Students working with a sound spectrum kit

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a frequency spectrum display showing a bar pattern, the learner interprets which sound type (a low hum, a high whistle, or general chatter) most likely produced it.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Play a sound type and read the resulting bar pattern; hover any bar for its band
pedagogical.assessment: Show a shape with the label hidden and ask which sound made it.
